kind: Setup-only observation; not application acceptance or a host repair
sourceGuard: Both support hashes are verified before any imported helper code executes.

observations.host: Numeric CPU/memory counters and bounded PID/UID/CPU/RSS/executable-name projections; no argument or environment dump.
observations.timeout: Persist failed verdict and bounded command output before a single diagnostic window. Applies to Xcode/SDK/create/boot/bootstatus/runtime-list timeouts.
sampleTargets: Exact live owned setup command, verified by process identity and group
One same-user exact CoreSimulatorService with stable identity, Apple signature and exact code identifier

limits: No app download/build/install, Maestro, reader or account test.
No preboot CoreSimulator list warm-up, cache purge, service restart, unrelated-process signal or deadline increase.

Host snapshots add bounded work/time before and after boot; samples occur after an already-failed verdict and can affect observed state. A successful probe alone cannot prove a cure of the previous host delay.
Linux controlled tests do not prove macOS libproc/sample/service behavior; the one-shot CI observation remains required.
